description: This Java class handles the import process of center data into the Fineract system. It reads Excel files, processes center and meeting data, and issues commands to create or update centers and their schedules via Spring services.

classes.name: CenterImportHandler
classes.description: Main class implementing the ImportHandler interface to import centers and their meetings from Excel into the Fineract system.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Orchestrates reading the Excel workbook and importing centers and meetings, returning the count of successes and errors.

methods.name: readExcelFile
methods.description: Reads center data and meetings from the specified sheet and populates the respective lists.

methods.name: readMeeting
methods.description: Reads meeting schedule details from a row to create a CalendarData object.

methods.name: readCenter
methods.description: Reads center information from a row and creates a CenterData object.

methods.name: containsGroupId
methods.description: Checks if a group ID is already in the list of group members.

methods.name: importEntity
methods.description: Performs the import of center entities, handles errors, and updates the spreadsheet with results.

methods.name: writeCenterErrorMessage
methods.description: Writes error messages and status to the spreadsheet for failed imports.

methods.name: getProgressLevel
methods.description: Determines the import progress level based on status.

methods.name: importCenter
methods.description: Constructs and logs the command to create a center based on CenterData.

methods.name: setReportHeaders
methods.description: Sets report headers in the spreadsheet for export.

methods.name: importCenterMeeting
methods.description: Constructs and logs the command to create or update a calendar for a center.
